title: Balloon Pop
tagline: Tap, swipe and pop a sky full of silly balloons!
howToPlay: Tap or swipe balloons to pop them, or hold on the sky to blow up your own. Keep popping to meet new balloon friends and surprises.
learning: Hand–eye coordination, colours and shapes, and cause and effect

title: Bumper Ducks
tagline: Bonk, bounce and squeak! Rubber ducks in bumper boats chase bubbles, burst giant ones and splash each other out of the tub.
howToPlay: Drag anywhere (or use the arrow keys) to paddle, and tap 💨 (or Space) to dash and bonk. Grab bubbles and stars, open 🎁 for a surprise power, bump mama duck, frogs or paper boats to shake bubbles loose, and bonk friends right out of the water. Nobody is ever out, and up to four can play on their own devices.
learning: Steering and spatial awareness, cause and effect, and playing together

title: Bunny Hop
tagline: Hop, flip and boing Pip home through meadows, mushrooms, autumn woods and snow!
howToPlay: Tap anywhere to hop and tap again in the air to flip; hold to keep hopping. Pip runs home by himself, munching carrots and bouncing off springy mushrooms, with a surprise somewhere on every trip.
learning: Mostly fun: timing hops and flips builds rhythm and hand–eye coordination

title: Cake Stack
tagline: Stack a wobbly giant cake and throw an animal birthday party!
howToPlay: Tap to drop each sliding layer and build a towering cake, then tap the cake to decorate it, blow out the candles and pop the party balloons.
learning: Timing and a steady hand, with decorating just for fun

title: Crash Racers
tagline: Race the robot cars, zoom through rainbows and bump for fun!
howToPlay: 🏁 Race three robot cars round Ubud, Helsinki, Montreal, Dino Valley or Stunt Park: drive through the rainbow arch (tap the big ⚡ button, or steer into it with ◀ ▶) for a burst of speed, sweep up a whole line of stars for a little one, and see where you finish on the podium. 🎪 Bumpers is bumper cars with the robots coming round to bump you; hold 🅿️ to park and see everyone's 💥. Grown-ups: hold 🧸 to switch Easy mode off or on. Up to four friends can join from their own devices.
learning: Steering, timing and reading a race map

title: Dragon Glide
tagline: Swoop baby dragon Ember through cloud rings, sparkly treasures and rainbow skies!
howToPlay: Touch or drag anywhere (or use the arrow keys) and Ember flies there, through four sky worlds of cloud rings, gems, hearts, stars and moons; tap or hold 🔥 (or Space) to puff fire that pops bubbles, wakes lanterns, launches fireworks and lights up night stars. Each world has its own surprise, and at each nest the treasures land with Ember's family before a tap on ▶ flies on.
learning: Mostly pure flying fun: steering and hand-eye coordination, with colours, shapes and cause and effect along the way

title: Fish Pond
tagline: Feel the tug, see the splash, find out what you caught!
howToPlay: Tap the water near a fish to cast, tap again when the bobber dips and the ! pops up, and tickle your catch before it flies into the picture book. Five places, 23 creatures, and surprises to find: big ones, sparkly shiny ones, a golden fish, a whale and treasure.
learning: Fun first: watching for the bite and tapping at just the right moment, and noticing who lives in which water

title: Memory Match
tagline: Flip the cards and wake up the animal twins!
howToPlay: Tap a card to flip it and meet the animal hiding underneath, then find its twin: matched animals turn to each other, call out together and do their own trick, and a full board ends in a party (a conga, a ring dance or a musical wave). Every board is a new place (garden, farm, sea, night, snow, savanna, autumn wood) and may hide a surprise: a golden crowned pair, babies whose parents pop up, party hats or a peekaboo. Pick a board size by its picture of cards, from 4 up to 16; hold 🏠 to leave a board and hold 🔊 to mute (a tap turns the sound back on).
learning: Mostly giggles: flipping, finding and watching animals do their tricks. Remembering where things are comes along with the play

title: Paint Splash
tagline: Roll, throw and splat paint everywhere with up to 4 friends!
howToPlay: Drag anywhere to roll your animal's paint roller, tap a pot (red, yellow, blue or rainbow) to change colour, and tap anywhere on the ground to throw a paint ball there. Each round hides surprises such as star, heart and paw stamps, a giant tipping bucket, rainbow and water puddles; tap 🖼️ when the picture is done, or pick ⏳ on the menu for a quick sand-timer round.
learning: Colour mixing by discovery: two wet paints blend where they cross (red and yellow make orange, yellow and blue make green, red and blue make purple), plus playing together

title: Penguin Bowling
tagline: Belly-slide a chubby penguin into wobbly snowmen and watch them tumble!
howToPlay: Swipe up from the penguin to send it whooshing down the ice (a curvy swipe curves it), or tap the big yellow slide button for a lucky-dip slide; ◀ ▶ move it, and it lines itself up with the pins left for the second slide. Five frames full of surprises (giant snowmen, golden pins, a cheeky pin that jumps the penguin, conga lines), strikes win hats you can pick on the title card, and 🏠, 🎵 and 🔊 need a short hold during play.
learning: Aiming, cause and effect, and a feel for the pins left standing

title: Rocket Garage
tagline: Snap together a silly rocket and blast it to the Moon, or watch it flop!
howToPlay: Tap parts to build a silly rocket, tap a planet on the top bar to choose where to go, press the big red 🚀, then tap or tilt to steer for stars. Wobbly rockets need bigger boosters, or they flop back onto the pad.
learning: Just for fun: building, steering and silly surprises (boosters and wobbly parts change the flight)

title: Star Catcher
tagline: Fly Kitty's rocket, catch falling stars, and watch your star pictures come alive!
howToPlay: Drag a finger (or use the arrow keys) to fly Kitty's rocket into the falling stars, and each planet sends its own kind, from bouncy candies to stars in bubbles. Every finished star picture wakes up as a bear, fish, bird, bunny, butterfly or cat that plays, follows the rocket and does a trick when tapped (hold 🏠 to leave a trip).
learning: Hand-eye coordination, tracking moving things, and spotting shapes in the stars
